Lena (Partnerships): Quick sync: we need a minimal onboarding contract for open-model providers so we can list in cloud marketplaces + bundle with HW/SIs. Main knobs: rehost consent, sublicensing, SKU naming, export flags, and embargo windows.
Marco (Marketplace): Minimal SKU suggestion: `vendor.model.build.region.bundle`. Keeps things searchable.
Ivy (Legal): We need an explicit `consent_rehost` and `allow_sublicense` in the contract. If no consent -> we only link to upstream (no hosting). Also capture SPDX id.
Raj (HW): For hardware bundles add `hw_rev` and `perf_profile` to metadata. Bundled SKUs should include `hw` token.
Sam (Ops): Ops needs a signed `manifest.json` with `sha256` and `export_classification`. If `export_classification` != "unrestricted" we auto-block regions.
Lena (Partnerships): UX asks for a small provenance badge: [Upstream | Partner build | Vendor fork] and a tooltip linking to manifest.
Ivy (Legal): Draft clause: "Supplier grants Redwood non-exclusive right to rehost and distribute subject to manifest fields and attribution. Supplier retains copyright. Redistribution must preserve license and attribution. Redwood will perform export vetting." (internal review pending).
Marco (Marketplace): Announcement timing: marketplaces often need ~10 business days for approvals. If partner sets `co_marketing_days` > 0 we hold listing until launch date.
Raj (HW): SI/forked builds should be distinct SKUs and have configurable revenue splits. Example minimal manifest: `{"vendor":"acme","model":"sparrow-7b","spdx":"Apache-2.0","sha256":"deadbeef","build":"q4-hw1","export":"unrestricted","provenance":"Partner build"}`
Sam (Ops): Action items: Ivy -> final clause by Wed; Marco -> SKU + badge specs by Thu; Raj -> HW metadata examples by Thu; Sam -> manifest validator webhook by next Mon.
